4. Check your email/text for a **reset link or verification code**.
   - Also check **spam/junk** folders.

   - Security questions
   - Trusted device/contact

7. Sign in and, if available, update your recovery email/phone.

If that doesn’t work:

- **Work/school account:** contact your IT help desk.
- **Email/social account:** use the provider’s **account recovery form** and provide as much info as possible.
- **Windows/Mac/iPhone/Android:** use the official recovery flow:
  - Microsoft: account.live.com/password/reset
  - Apple: iforgot.apple.com
  - Google: accounts.google.com/signin/recovery
- **No recovery options or locked out:** contact the service’s support. They may ask for proof of ownership.

Security tips:
- Never share reset codes with anyone.
- Use a unique password you don’t reuse.
- Turn on **2FA** and keep recovery info updated.

  - Google: accounts.google.com/signin/recovery

- Never share reset codes with anyone.
- Use a unique password you don’t reuse.
- Turn on **2FA** and keep recovery info updated.

If you signed up with **Google, Microsoft, or Apple**, you may need to reset the password with that provider instead.

If you don’t get the email:
- Check spam/junk.
- Wait a few minutes and try again.
- Make sure you’re using the right email.
- Contact the service’s support.
